description: List this workspace's phone lines (provider, default, mode, test numbers, ring window, live health, inbound answering, telco warning) and the providers this deployment offers. Secrets are never returned. `callBlockers` lists what would stop this line's calls right now ({code, message, fix: {label, path} | null, affects: inbound/outbound}), e.g. no processing region or no answering agent: tell the user and point them to `fix.path` on the website. `lastRefused` is the newest call SAGOT didn't answer on this line in the last 7 days.
name: lines_list
